fit_decision_checklist.suit: This occupation suits careful, patient people who enjoy interacting with others. It is a strong fit if you can repeatedly examine older adults and children without frustration and want to master equipment operation.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can accept a healthcare pace defined by standardized processes and repetitive operations, but also stability, cleanliness, and growing proficiency, this career is worthwhile.
